snippet.title: Windrose: Thank You / Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Today we celebrate another milestone and some of the reviews the game received. But first of all, we thank YOU for making this possible, captains!

Windrose is available on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041230/Windrose/
